title: Awesome bodybuilding program
author: Austin D.
desc: This is a 5 day split program with undulating intensity to manage fatigue and maximize strength and gains without leaving any gains on the table, each set is near or to failure, the start of the week is supposed to be done with lighter weights to failure and at the end of the week it's heavier sets to failure.
